resolution_criteria: Resolve YES if the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation release for July 2026 reports a seasonally adjusted civilian unemployment rate of 4.3 percent or higher. Use the initially published July 2026 value, not a later revision.
title: Will the U.S. unemployment rate for July 2026 be at least 4.3%?

resolution_criteria: Resolve YES if the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index release for July 2026 reports an all-items CPI-U 12-month percent change, not seasonally adjusted, of 3.5 percent or higher. Use the initially published value.
title: Will U.S. all-items CPI inflation for July 2026 be at least 3.5% year over year?

resolution_criteria: Resolve YES if the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis second estimate for 2026 Q2 reports annualized real GDP growth from the preceding quarter below 2.0 percent. Use the headline percent change in real GDP in the August 26 release.
title: Will the U.S. 2026 Q2 real GDP second estimate be below 2.0% annualized?

resolution_criteria: Resolve YES if the ECB monetary policy decision published for the September 9-10, 2026 meeting sets the deposit facility rate above 2.25 percent. Resolve NO if it is 2.25 percent or lower.
title: Will the ECB deposit facility rate be above 2.25% after its September 2026 meeting?

resolution_criteria: Resolve YES if the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index release for August 2026 reports an all-items CPI-U 12-month percent change, not seasonally adjusted, of 3.5 percent or higher. Use the initially published value.
title: Will U.S. all-items CPI inflation for August 2026 be at least 3.5% year over year?

resolution_criteria: Resolve YES if the Federal Open Market Committee statement for the September 15-16, 2026 meeting sets the upper bound of the federal funds target range below 3.75 percent. Resolve NO if the upper bound is 3.75 percent or higher.
title: Will the upper bound of the federal funds target range be below 3.75% after the September 2026 FOMC meeting?
